## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve, or what opportunity does it address?  
_e.g. "As a visitor, I can't easily find upcoming events because..."_

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this could be implemented. Include any mockups or sketches if you have them.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you thought of other ways to solve this? Why did you prefer this approach?

## Additional Context

Any other context, links, or references that might be helpful.
